hypotheses.title: Batch 90: Orthogonal Frontiers & Unmined Factor Sprint
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly resolves the user's priority to maximize Leaderboard Uniqueness and eliminate formula template recycling by exploring three completely unmined data domains and novel mathematical structures: (1) Candidate 1: Equity Options Implied Borrow & Cost-of-Carry Term Slope (forward_price_90 - forward_price_30) in options, measuring institutional equity financing rates and short borrow stability. (2) Candidate 2: Balance Sheet Net Cash Solvency & Total Debt Cushion (cash_st / (debt_lt + debt_st + cash_st)) in fundamental, deploying structural credit risk modeling with zero unit warnings. (3) Candidate 3: Forward Cash Flow & Dividend Consensus Yield in analyst4, combining consensus forward CFPS (anl4_afv4_cfps_mean) with forward dividend yield (anl4_afv4_div_mean). Zero signed_power, zero price-delta hedges, and 100% unit-clean.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if options forward slope, balance sheet solvency, or forward cash flow yield fail to produce Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50 under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Options Implied Borrow Rate & Cost of Carry Term Slope): Exploits the term structure of equity forward prices in options markets. In institutional derivatives, forward price F_T = S_0 * exp((r - q - b) * T), where b is the equity lending fee. Steep forward contango (forward_price_90 > forward_price_30) signals minimal shorting demand, zero inventory congestion, and positive risk-adjusted carry. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 2 (Balance Sheet Net Cash Solvency & Total Debt Cushion): Structural credit model isolating companies with dominant short-term liquid reserves (cash_st) relative to their aggregate debt stack (debt_lt + debt_st + cash_st). Evaluates the 1-year historical percentile ranking (ts_rank(..., 252)) to identify firms whose solvency buffer is at peak historical strength within their subindustry. Dimensionally clean with zero unit warnings. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 3 (Forward Cash Flow & Dividend Consensus Yield): Deploys sell-side forward consensus forecasts for Cash Flow Per Share (anl4_afv4_cfps_mean) and Dividend Per Share (anl4_afv4_div_mean) normalized by spot price close. Cash flows are impervious to accrual accounting manipulation, while dividends represent tangible equity return of capital. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.
